words.explanation: a. involving small details and needing a lot of attention and special knowledge or skill 专业技术的；专业性
words.example: Many books on furniture making are too technical.

words.explanation: n. [U] the act or process of controlling and organizing the work of a company or organization and the people who work for it 管理；经营
words.example: The failure of the company was a direct result of poor management.

words.explanation: n. [sing.] ( infml. ) an idea, plan, organization, etc. that sb. has thought of without any help from anyone else 智力产儿；脑力劳动的成果
n. [C] the first public appearance of an entertainer, sports player, etc. or of sth. new and important（演员、运动员等的）首次登台，初次亮相；（新事物的）问世
words.example: She is hoping her debut will be the first step on the road to fame and fortune.

words.explanation: vi. to talk in a friendly informal way, esp. about things that are not important 闲谈；聊天
words.example: We had chatted with each other online for a long time before we decided to date.

words.explanation: n. [U] the activity of meeting and talking to people to exchange information and advice about work or interests 交流；沟通
vt. to try to judge the value, size, speed, cost, etc. of sth., partly by calculating and partly by guessing 估计；估算
words.example: It is estimated that over 75 percent of our customers are women.

words.explanation: num. 十亿
ad. including or affecting the whole world 全球地
words.example: We need to start thinking globally in order to make good decisions.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who is trying to find or get sth. 寻找者；追求者
words.example: When I decided to do research on news, I told myself to be a seeker after truth.

words.explanation: n. [C] a company or person that provides a service 供应者；供应商
a. ( only before noun ) possible or likely in the future 可能的；潜在的
words.example: A number of potential buyers have shown interest in the new products.

words.explanation: n. [C] a rule, problem, etc. that prevents people from doing sth., or limits what they can do（阻止或限制人们做事的）障碍
words.example: Lack of career experience is a barrier for her to find a good job.

words.explanation: vt. to find the exact position of sb. or sth. 找出、确定（某人或某物的）的准确位置
words.example: The GPS system in smartphones can help us locate the places where we want to go.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] the process of considering how things or people are different and how they are similar 比较
words.example: There are no previous statistics for comparison.

words.explanation: vt. to stop sb. from using as much of sth. as they want or from behaving in the way they want （在使用或行为方面）限制，限定
words.example: We must limit the expenses to 2,000 yuan a month.

words.explanation: a. relating to business and the buying and selling of goods and services 商业的；商务的；贸易的
words.example: Businessmen first consider profit and commercial growth.

words.explanation: n. [C] a complete change in ways of thinking, methods of working, etc.（思维、工作方式等的）彻底变革
words.example: A revolution in mobile technology is taking place.

words.explanation: n. [U] the activity of doing business using the Internet 电子商务
vt. to get or achieve sth. important, esp. after a lot of effort（尤指经过大量努力而）获得，得到（某物）
words.example: We secured a place in the final basketball match.

words.explanation: n. [C] an official mark put on your passport by the representative of a foreign country, that gives you permission to enter, pass through, stay in, or leave that country 签证
v. to move information to your computer from a computer system or the Internet 下载
words.example: You cannot download this movie online without paying.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who buys and uses products and services 消费者
words.example: Consumers' confidence reached an all-time low in March.

words.explanation: n. [C] ( the ~ ) the world 地球；世界
words.example: Her travels had taken her to every corner of the globe.

words.explanation: a. happening in or relating to the country, not the city 农村的；乡村的；田园的
words.example: Much of his early work is concerned with the life in rural areas.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who establishes a business, organization, school, etc.（公司、组织、学校等的）创立者，创办人；始创者
v. to decay by a gradual natural process, or to make sth. do this（使）腐败；（使）腐烂
words.example: The dead leaves of the tree rotted in the soil.

words.explanation: n. [U] the sale of goods in stores to customers, for their own use and not for selling to anyone else 零售
words.example: My dad owns a chain of retail stores.

words.explanation: n. [U] the act of paying 支付；付款
words.example: Most hotels here only accept payment in cash.

words.explanation: vt. to hold sth. and move it from side to side 挥动（某物）
words.example: The judge waved a green ﬂag to indicate that the match would begin.

words.explanation: n. [C] 条形码扫描识别仪
n. [C] a new idea, method, or invention 新观念；新方法；新发明
words.example: We all benefit from the latest technological innovations.

words.explanation: vt. to move money from the control of one account or institution to another 把（钱）转到另一账户（机构）
words.example: How could I transfer money from my bank account to his?

words.explanation: n. [C] the end of a finger 指尖
if a computer system goes live, all the tests on it have been completed and it can now be used （计算机系统）激活
words.example: The computer system went live in this research center, marking that we are entering into a new IT era.

words.explanation: to make sth. happen 引起；导致；造成
words.example: His carelessness brought about the accident.

words.explanation: ( infml. ) because of sth. or sb. 归功于…；多亏了…
words.example: Thanks to the doctor, his condition has greatly improved.

words.explanation: to speak or write to sb. when you cannot see them as often as you used to 保持联系
words.example: She keeps in touch with her classmates in primary school.

words.explanation: used to say that one thing can happen or be true only if another thing happens or is true 只要
words.example: You can go as long as you finish your housework.

words.explanation: to exist or happen only in a particular place, group, or area of activity 局限于某处（团体、范围）
words.example: The damage of the wind was limited to the window.

words.explanation: if you have sth. at your fingertips, it is ready and available to use very easily 随时可供使用
words.example: Bob has all the information he needs at his fingertips.
